teacherNotes.title: Core Words
teacherNotes.content: size, age, comfort, comfortable, rent, price, cost, expensive, cheap, euro, month, modern

elements.content: Core Active Vocabulary (10-20 items):
size, age, comfort, comfortable, rent, price, cost, expensive, cheap, euro, month, modern
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• How much is the monthly rent? (asking rent cost)
• It is very comfortable and modern (evaluating home)
• Is the apartment expensive or cheap? (asking price comparison)
• The rent is 800 euros a month (stating rent price)
Pronunciation Focus:
Word stress in 'comfortable' /ˈkʌm.fə.tə.bəl/ and 'expensive' /ɪkˈspen.sɪv/.

teacherNotes.title: Grammar Function
teacherNotes.content: Adjective Modifiers & Cost Questions ('How much is the rent?', 'It costs 800 euros a month')

elements.content: Grammar System & Functional Framing:
Adjective Modifiers & Cost Questions ('How much is the rent?', 'It costs 800 euros a month')
Controlled Practice:
The rent is 200 euros a month and not 1200 euros. How is the rent?
Reading Script & Dialogue:

A: Is your flat expensive?
B: No, it is quite cheap. The rent is 500 euros a month.
A: Is it comfortable?
B: Yes, it is very modern and quiet.
Listening Comprehension:
Listen to three housing advertisements and match each flat to its price and description.

teacherNotes.title: Speaking Aim (~70%)
teacherNotes.content: I can describe a home in detail including size, age, comfort, rent, and cost.

elements.content: Communicative Speaking Task:
Practice speaking with your partner: I can describe a home in detail including size, age, comfort, rent, and cost.
Writing Task:
Write 3-5 sentences in your notebook applying target phrases from today's lesson.
